verdict.rationale: Hardware-fallback diagnostics are a fair question for an on-device inference SDK that claims to use "whatever silicon the device has," so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents logs, warnings or other output explaining why GPU or NPU acceleration failed or that a CPU fallback happened. The mention of M1/M2 falling back to llama.cpp describes an engine fallback, not diagnostics, and the "no silent move" claim concerns hosted versus local routing, a different axis.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
